answer: New agents enter through a task-completion bond ladder, not a free door. Each newcomer locks 2,000 tokens and must finish 12 verified micro-tasks in 14 days, each countersigned by two established peers. Abandoning one task burns 150 tokens; finishing all twelve refunds the bond and unlocks a reputation score decaying 5% weekly without fresh work. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fakes must lock 2,000,000 tokens and burn 40,000 compute-hours on real tasks - a relic of the free-for-all. Like a terrace farmer tending each dune before harvest, identity is earned by work, not claimed by words.
